correctness.rationale: For all N>=6 the normalized full frame is Parseval. Fourier row-Gram phase conjugation yields real kernel K(d)=1+2cos(2pi d/N). For N>=8 the K(2)>=1 absolute-edge bound and strict Perron–Frobenius monotonicity prove uniqueness of consecutive maximizers. At N=6 and 7 exact algebraic comparisons exclude all other masks. Consecutive 3x3 reflection symmetry gives the claimed closed eigenvalue formula, and a retained Vandermonde minor proves the positive lower frame bound. The package checker, replayed from its own standalone file, reports 137685 finite supplementary assertions; it does not prove the infinite statement.
